details.description: Claude Mythos Preview is Anthropic's first frontier-class model in its access-restricted Mythos line, announced April 7, 2026 as part of Project Glasswing, a defensive-cybersecurity initiative offered to more than 50 vetted organizations (11 named launch partners plus over 40 additional organizations) rather than the general public. Anthropic describes it as a strong general-purpose model that is especially capable at computer-security tasks such as vulnerability discovery and exploit development, with a 1M-token context window and 128K-token maximum output over text and image input. Anthropic superseded it on June 9, 2026 with the generally available Claude Mythos 5 (and its public counterpart Claude Fable 5), and its model-deprecations page now lists Mythos Preview as Deprecated.
advantages: Discovered thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities across every major operating system and web browser during pre-release testing, including a 27-year-old OpenBSD TCP flaw and a 16-year-old FFmpeg codec vulnerability, per Anthropic's Mythos Preview research post.
Achieved 181 successful exploits of Firefox 147 JavaScript vulnerabilities in testing, versus 2 for Claude Opus 4.6, per Anthropic's research post.

Achieved full control-flow hijack (tier 5) on ten fully patched OSS-Fuzz targets, while Claude Opus 4.6 reached no better than a single tier-3 crash and no tier-5 hijacks, per Anthropic's research post.

Can autonomously reverse-engineer stripped binaries and chain multiple vulnerabilities into multi-stage exploits without further human intervention after the initial prompt, per Anthropic's research post.
disadvantages: Restricted, invitation-only research preview: not generally available, offered only to vetted organizations through Project Glasswing rather than the public API.
Deprecated as of June 9, 2026, when Claude Mythos 5 and the public Claude Fable 5 superseded it; Anthropic's model-deprecations page marks it Deprecated with retirement date 'to be announced'.
Anthropic reports it was unsuccessful at remotely exploiting some Linux kernel vulnerabilities it found, and could not produce certain browser exploits without human assistance.
use_cases: Defensive cybersecurity research: vulnerability discovery, exploit development, and penetration testing for vetted security teams under Project Glasswing
Reverse-engineering stripped binaries and reconstructing source code for security analysis
Black-box testing of binaries and endpoint-security hardening
Open-source software hardening, supported by Anthropic funding to organizations such as OpenSSF and the Apache Software Foundation

sources.title: Project Glasswing: Securing critical software for the AI era
Claude on Amazon Bedrock (Opus 4.6 and earlier) - Claude Platform Docs

notes: Catalog has no deprecation_date for claude-mythos-preview; Anthropic's model-deprecations page lists it Deprecated since June 9, 2026 with retirement 'to be announced', superseded by the GA Claude Mythos 5 / Claude Fable 5 line. This is a restricted research-preview model with access limited to vetted Project Glasswing partners; anthropic.com/claude/mythos (the general marketing page) now describes the current Mythos 5.1 rather than this Preview snapshot, so claims specific to 5.1 were excluded.
